title: Prone Versus Left-sided Colonoscopy in Obese Patients
brief_summary: For obese patients, a randomized trial aimed at determining whether colonoscopy performance and patient comfort is improved if a patient is in the prone position (lay on their abdomen) versus the traditional left-sided position.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI \>30kg/m2
* Elective Colonoscopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with prior colonic resection, strictures, or known colonic or intra-abdominal malignancy.
* Patients who are scheduled to have monitored or general anesthesia for their procedure.
* Emergency colonoscopy
* Inadequate preparation of the colon as assessed during colonoscopy
